title: announcements draft fails on the signed-in lane: Delivery records are writable only by AWS roles
description: papyrus announcements draft (and the other editing-window writes) runs locally with the person's client and fails with Not Authorized to access updateDelivery. The announcementsWrite door (PPY PR 1807) serves only delivery review set; the editing-window operations need the same door, or a person cannot edit an announcement's words from the CLI or console.
